tasks.subject: Task 1: Announce mode Auto/Native + diagnostic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the silently-broken default (in-app announcements owned by window-level NSAccessibility posts, unheard across 3 builds) with an "Auto" default routing in-app speech through the web live region, keep "Native" as an opt-in menu mode, and add one log line that makes the native path diagnosable forever.

**Files:**
- Modify: `applio_launcher.py:4841-4852` (owner set in `__init__`), `:5493-5518` (`_a11y_post`), settings setters + `_push_a11y_settings`, `menu_spec.py:77-83` (A11Y_CHILD_KEYS) + Accessibility submenu items, `applio_progress_api.py` settings echo
- Test: `tests/test_menu_spec.py` (15 → 17), `tests/test_progress_api.py` (11 → 12)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Persisted `a11y.announce_mode` ∈ {"auto","native"}, default "auto", two new submenu items (a11y.announce.auto "Announcements: Auto (recommended)", a11y.announce.native "Announcements: Native (experimental)"), checkmark on active, persisted like a11y.verbosity.
- [ ] Mode→owner: auto → set_announce_owner("web"); native → set_announce_owner("native"); applied at __init__ and on change.
- [ ] `_a11y_post` under auto: SKIPS applio_a11y.post_announcement (keeps requestUserAttention_, sound cues, [A11y] log); under native: unchanged. One instrumentation log line (mode, isVoiceOverEnabled, element) before the decision, exception-guarded.
- [ ] Payload settings echo carries announce_mode; per-request owner rule UNTOUCHED (external browsers unaffected).
- [ ] Suites: menu_spec (17), progress_api (12), applio_a11y (17) green.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py && venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_progress_api.py && venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_applio_a11y.py` → (17)/(12)/(17).

tasks.subject: Task 2: patch_job_toasts.py lifecycle toasts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The jobs that start/finish silently get announced through gradio toasts (the VoiceOver-proven channel), injected at build time via a new multi-target patcher modeled on patch_stop_feedback.py — the code that later becomes the upstream Applio PR.

**Files:**
- Create: `patches/patch_job_toasts.py`
- Modify: `build_macos.py` patches_to_apply (+4 "dir" tuples; NEVER import it — verify via --help)
- Test: `tests/test_patch_fixtures.py` (+1 → 6), `tests/test_patcher_exit_codes.py` (CASES +1, count stays 2)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Injection per the plan's verbatim spec: inference.py enforce_terms (start + finish + error; marker _APPLIO_TOASTS_INFERENCE); tts.py enforce_terms (same shape, _APPLIO_TOASTS_TTS); train.py enforce_terms START-only (_APPLIO_TOASTS_TRAIN) + two wrapper defs (_applio_preprocess_toast/_applio_extract_toast, error-prefix gr.Warning) + fn= rewires at the two unique literals; download.py wrapper for fn=run_download_script (_APPLIO_TOASTS_DOWNLOAD). enforce_terms_batch gets NO toasts (Task 3 owns batch). Existing toasts (download.py:146/161, train.py:861-872) untouched.
- [ ] Patcher: TARGETS multi-target, apply() resolves file- or dir-type args, per-sub-patch OWN markers, exit 0 patched/already + 2 on miss, usage guard 1.
- [ ] Double-run → already/0; mutated anchor temp copy → 2; patched outputs py_compile clean.
- [ ] Registered (4 tuples); --help exits 0; fixture test +1 (injected lines verbatim per file); exit-codes CASES + patch_job_toasts; tree restored clean after tests.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_patch_fixtures.py && venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_patcher_exit_codes.py && venv_macos/bin/python build_macos.py --help` → (6)/(2)/help+0.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Batch toasts engine-side
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The batch flow gets start, 25/50/75% milestone, completion/cancelled, and error toasts — all inside the fork-owned INFER_BATCH_REPLACEMENT body of patch_inference_progress.py (verified: gradio contextvars live on the handler thread mid-loop; toasts deliver immediately via SSE).

**Files:**
- Modify: `patches/patch_inference_progress.py` — INFER_PROGRESS_HELPERS (+_infer_toast), INFER_BATCH_REPLACEMENT (loop entry ~L166, terminal ~L208-218, error ~L226-244)
- Test: `tests/test_inference_progress.py` (pytest, 5 → 7)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `_infer_toast(msg)` helper: lazy `import gradio as gr; gr.Info(msg)` in try/except with print fallback; gradio NEVER imported at top of generated engine code.
- [ ] Start before the loop: `_infer_toast(f"Batch conversion started: {total} files")`.
- [ ] Milestones: `_next_milestone = 25`; after each per-file progress write, when `total >= 8` and `processed * 100 // total >= _next_milestone`: toast `f"{processed}/{total} files converted ({_next_milestone}%)"`, then `_next_milestone += 25`. Small batches: start+terminal only.
- [ ] Terminal block: `_infer_toast(f"Batch conversion {status}: {converted} converted, {skipped} skipped in {elapsed:.0f}s")`; error block: toast before the existing raise (covers the concurrent-run RuntimeError → tab-side except stays toast-free).
- [ ] pytest +2: milestone/terminal/error toast calls present in generated output; `import gradio` only inside _infer_toast.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_inference_progress.py -q` → `7 passed`.


tasks.subject: Task 5: Dashboard readability (AX values)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the Process Dashboard readable by a blind user: rows announce metrics, progress announces template text, the loss chart's value summarizes the curve, Tab deterministically exits the runs list, and selecting a row announces its summary.

**Files:**
- Modify: `applio_launcher.py` — module-level `_row_ax_summary(proc, metrics=None, total_epoch=None, eta=None)`; ProcessDashboardController: new `tableView_didAddRowView_forRow_`, progress-value templates 3190-3192/3420-3422, indeterminate branch 3194-3201, LossChartView.set_points value 2434-2447 (built at MODULE level, never a view method), key-view loop in _create_detail_panel, selection announcement in tableViewSelectionDidChange_ 3896-3916, dead status_badge branch 3045-3048 removed
- Test: NEW `tests/test_dashboard_ax.py` (3 tests, pure builder)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `_row_ax_summary`: training `f"epoch {cur} of {total}, best loss {best:.4g}, ETA {eta}"`; inference `f"{processed} of {total} files converted, {pct:.0f} percent"`; unknown → ""; native_tr at call time.
- [ ] Row values: `tableView_didAddRowView_forRow_` sets rowView accessibilityLabel ("Training run {name}"/"Inference batch {name}") + Value (summary) via the dataSource row arithmetic; visible cell stays short.
- [ ] Progress: training `"Epoch {cur} of {total}, {int(frac*100)} percent"`; inference `"{processed} of {total} files, {int(pct)} percent"`; indeterminate → "Working, no metrics yet" (fixes stale value).
- [ ] Chart value: full summary (epochs plotted, range, fell-from/to, best @ epoch, significant improvements count) + "no data yet" case; module-level builder.
- [ ] Key-view loop: process_table → stop → pause → reveal → open → process_table (setNextKeyView_, once).
- [ ] Selection announcement: gated on isVoiceOverEnabled + verbosity != off, post_announcement(process_table, summary + "Detail pane updated."), main-thread, try/except-wrapped.
- [ ] Dead status_badge branch deleted; tests/test_dashboard_ax.py (3) green; test_applio_a11y (17) green.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_dashboard_ax.py && venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_applio_a11y.py` → (3)/(17).

tasks.subject: Task 7: Full chain + frozen build (gate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the branch regression-free end to end: all suites green with new counts, cert-free frozen build completes with all patchers (incl. patch_job_toasts) exiting 0, bundle carries the new code, the running app serves the progress route with announce_mode in settings, and patched tab sources ship in the bundle.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task enforces the owner's standing ruling (2026-08-21, verbatim): "no PR until we have everything 100% test, verified, and confirmed working with 0 regression bug." It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptance criterion has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** none (validation only; artifacts gitignored).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All suites green: applio_a11y (17), menu_spec (17), native_picker (3), browse_ui (9), progress_api (12), patch_fixtures (6), applio_i18n (9), a11y_js_invariants (2), patcher_exit_codes (2), menu_jobs (4), dashboard_ax (3), pytest inference_progress (7) — 91 total (adjust/report legitimate shifts).
- [ ] Cert-free build: background run, build as FINAL command, BUILD COMPLETE, every Patching: line incl. the 4 job_toasts registrations, zero PATCH FAILURE; post-build restore if dirty; tree clean.
- [ ] Bundle: binary timestamp AFTER last commit; patched tab sources in the bundle carry the _APPLIO_TOASTS_* markers (`find dist/Applio.app/Contents -name "inference.py"` + rg); assets/applio_a11y.js unchanged vs main (Task 1 touches no JS).
- [ ] Boot smoke: launch dist/Applio.app, poll `curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:6969/applio-a11y/progress?client=web"` → JSON contains "announce_mode", quit via osascript.
- [ ] No pushes, no PRs, no tags.
